policy.route_lengths: Record same-goal old remaining and new length at rebuild; no unconditional length cap can authorize unsafe cached-route reuse.

budget.scope: Offline fixed eight-run regression gate only; never read by control/planning. Fixed before v9 production experiments. Each reference is the faster successful run at identical timing from committed v7/v8 reports.

scope: Offline real-worker 2x2 functional timing comparison. No Q/R, limits, budgets or other configuration changes. Observer overhead included in host wall_time_ms, no timing-performance claim.

comparison.scope: Actual outputs aligned by model time; plans and returned navigation path aligned by identical source capture stamp. This path includes the current projected position and remaining reference segment. Exact point/count differences need not mean replanning or different topology; consult revision, rebuild reason and phase. Null means no difference in the common captured interval only when traces_complete=true.
